login.descriptionFirst: Connect your machines and native toolchains
login.descriptionSecond: into one observable, traceable delivery pipeline.
login.title: Sign in to the build console
login.description: Use your assigned account to access the workspace.
login.notice: For trusted internal teams. The control plane authorizes access to accounts, nodes and artifacts.

register.title: Create a workspace account
register.description: Register for read-only access to this instance's projects, builds and artifacts.
register.loginDescription: Sign in with an existing account or create a read-only account.
register.notice: Self-registered accounts can view all projects and artifacts in this instance, but cannot start builds or perform administrative actions.
register.passwordHint: 12–256 bytes; ASCII letters, numbers and symbols each use one byte.
register.disabled: Self-registration is disabled on this instance.
register.configFailed: Could not load registration settings. Please try again later.
register.failed: Registration failed. Please try again later.
register.invalidUsername: Enter a username of 1–100 bytes, not just whitespace.
register.invalidPassword: Your password must be 12–256 bytes long.
register.invalidFields: Invalid registration details. Check your username and password.
register.usernameTaken: This username is already in use. Choose another one.
register.forbidden: Registration was denied. Self-registration may be disabled; refresh the page and try again.
register.rateLimited: Too many registration attempts. Please try again later.

overview.title: Build. Sign. Deliver.
overview.description: Observe cross-platform delivery in one place. Every status comes from an actual execution record.
overview.installEmissary: Install an Emissary on a machine, then enroll it with a one-time token.
overview.traceable: Pinned source. AI plans. Traceable delivery.
overview.configPrefix: The platform analyzes source and stores the
overview.configSuffix: , then dispatches it to authorized, capable nodes.
overview.queued: {count, plural, one {# job queued} other {# jobs queued}}
overview.registered: {count, plural, one {# registered node} other {# registered nodes}}

projects.description: Connect Git read-only. AI analyzes a pinned snapshot and generates the build plan.
projects.notFoundDetail: Check the address or choose a project from the project list.
projects.firstDetail: Use self-hosted Git over HTTPS or SSH. Keep your code on your preferred hosting platform.
projects.name: Project name
projects.repositoryHint: Use HTTPS, ssh:// or git@host:path. SSH requires verified known_hosts entries.
projects.signingHint: Enter comma-separated reference names. Private keys stay on nodes, which must bind the same references.
projects.dialogDetail: Authorize the repository, node pools and signing references. Instructions and execution plans stay on the platform.
projects.poolCount: {count, plural, one {# authorized node pool} other {# authorized node pools}}
projects.signingCount: {count, plural, one {# signing reference} other {# signing references}}

wizard.title: Start build
wizard.description: One question at a time. No build is created until you confirm your choices.
wizard.projectQuestion: Which project would you like to build?
wizard.projectHint: Reuse this project's repository credentials, node pools and model configuration.
wizard.sourceHint: Choose a branch, tag or commit. This list is a preview; the platform pins the actual source snapshot after you start the build.
wizard.goalHint: Choose a common goal and add any details. AI will analyze it without modifying the source repository.
wizard.platformHint: Let AI select platforms using the source and authorized node capabilities, or choose explicitly. Offline nodes do not restrict your choices.
wizard.reviewHint: Review your configuration. You can edit any answer without losing the others.
wizard.summaryHint: Your choices, all in one place.
wizard.noRefs: No matching references. Try another category or enter a reference or commit manually.
wizard.refsLimited: Showing up to {count} matches, including your selection. Search to narrow the list.
wizard.manualHint: Enter a branch, full tag reference or commit. A failed query never silently falls back to HEAD.
wizard.goalBuildText: Build this project and collect distributable artifacts for the selected platforms.
wizard.goalTestText: Build this project, run relevant tests and collect distributable artifacts for the selected platforms.
wizard.goalInputHint: Describe the application, required tests or expected artifacts. Up to 16000 bytes.
wizard.autoPlatformsHint: AI selects platforms using the source and authorized node capabilities.
wizard.manualPlatformsHint: Build only the platforms you select. Multiple selections are supported.
wizard.releaseDescription: Publish final artifacts only after every target succeeds. No Git tags are created or pushed.
wizard.advancedHint: Usually unnecessary. Use a JSON object with string values, such as {example}.
wizard.submitHint: Confirmation starts source resolution and AI planning, followed by execution on authorized nodes.
wizard.noPermission: Your account does not have permission to start builds.
wizard.noProjectsHint: Connect a Git project first, or ask an administrator to configure one.
wizard.invalidRef: Choose a valid source reference, or enter 1–255 bytes without newlines or null characters and not starting with -.
wizard.invalidGoal: Enter a build goal of 1–16000 bytes.
wizard.invalidPlatforms: Select at least one platform or switch to automatic selection.
wizard.invalidVersion: Enter a Release version of 1–100 bytes without control characters.
wizard.invalidParameters: Parameters must be a JSON object: names start with an uppercase letter and contain only uppercase letters, digits and underscores (up to 64 characters); values are strings of up to 4096 bytes without null characters; the object must not exceed 16 KiB.

builds.description: Track every attempt, from source resolution to target execution.
builds.emptyDetail: Connect a Git project and start a build from a specific revision. Jobs run only on authorized, capable nodes.
builds.configFailed: Source resolution or AI planning did not complete. No execution jobs were created.
builds.readingConfig: Resolving source or generating an AI build plan…
builds.matching: Waiting for an authorized node with the required capabilities.
builds.retry: Retry target with a new attempt
builds.clipped: The browser retains the latest 3,000 log chunks. Server logs have not been deleted.
builds.noArtifactsDetail: Only objects verified by the server for size and SHA-256 appear here.
builds.publishDetail: Reuse this build's artifacts without rebuilding or signing again. Existing versions cannot be overwritten.
builds.refHint: The platform pins the commit, fetches submodules and LFS, then lets AI inspect that snapshot read-only.
builds.platformsHint: Select target platforms, or let AI choose from the goal and node capabilities.
builds.parametersHint: String parameters inform AI planning and become ARTIFACTORY_PARAM_ environment variables during execution.
builds.releaseHint: Leave empty to build only. A version requests publication after every target succeeds.
builds.dialogDetail: Describe the goal and pin the source. AI plans; authorized nodes execute native commands.
builds.resultDescription: Build and publication results are recorded separately · {date}

nodes.description: Nodes connect outbound. Jobs match real toolchains, authorized pools and available slots.
nodes.emptyDetail: Install the native Emissary on Linux, macOS or Windows. Enroll with the control plane CA and a one-time token. No inbound management port is required.
nodes.concurrencyHint: Defaults to 1. Consider shared SDKs, signing keychains and disk space before increasing concurrency.
nodes.signingHint: Must match signing_profiles in the Emissary configuration. This does not upload or create private keys.
nodes.drain: Drain node: keep active jobs, stop assigning new jobs
nodes.configureHint: Changing slots, labels or signing references does not install toolchains. Jobs still require a verified environment.
nodes.enrollHint: The token binds one node to a pool, expires in 15 minutes and is single-use. The Emissary must verify the control plane CA.
nodes.install: Install: get Emissary → verify binary checksum → configure trusted CA → enroll → run under a dedicated account → inspect diagnostics.
nodes.revokeDescription: Revoke {name}? The node will lose lease renewal access and active jobs will stop. Re-enrollment is required to restore access.

artifacts.description: Only server-verified artifacts appear here. Download links are authorized and short-lived.
artifacts.emptyDetail: After upload, the server reads the content, calculates SHA-256 and registers the artifact. Upload completion is separate from verification.

releases.description: Group successful cross-platform artifacts into immutable versions. Build and publication results are recorded separately.
releases.emptyDetail: Specify a release version when starting a build and enable publication in the configuration. All targets and signing checks must succeed first.
releases.notice: An internal release records artifact distribution. Store publication and device installation remain subject to each platform's certificates and provisioning requirements.

security.description: Manage identities, source credentials and signing keys separately. Trace every authorization and delivery.
security.credentialNotice: Only read-only Git credentials are stored here. Dedicated nodes hold Apple, Windows and Android signing keys. The platform manages references and authorization.
security.emptyTokens: Tokens are shown only once. Grant minimum permissions by project and read, build or release scope.
security.emptyDetail: The control plane records authorization and audit information as configuration is added.
security.tokenHint: Tokens cannot manage nodes or credentials, or exceed the current account's permissions.
security.credentialHint: Keys are stored encrypted. SSH host fingerprint verification cannot be skipped.
security.userHint: Administrators manage access. Operators build and publish. Viewers browse and download.
security.notice: API tokens and node certificates serve different purposes and are not interchangeable.

credentials.name: Credential name
credentials.secretHint: Only encrypted content is stored. Secrets will not be shown again. Do not enter application signing keys here.
credentials.knownHostsHint: Verify fingerprints through a trusted channel. Unverified ssh-keyscan output is not sufficient.

secrets.description: This value is shown only once. Store it securely, outside source code, build parameters and job logs.
secrets.emissaryHint: Use ARTIFACTORY_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN to enroll an Emissary. Node enrollment tokens expire in 15 minutes and can be used once.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: Use the navigation to return to the workspace.

preferences.title: Interface preferences
preferences.description: Choose your language, appearance and visual effects. Preferences are saved in this browser.
preferences.reduced: Your system's reduced motion preference is active.

ota.title: Emissary updates
ota.drainHint: Draining for update: waiting for builds, artifacts and log acknowledgments.
ota.activatingHint: Verifying the new version. Tasks resume after confirmation or rollback.
ota.poolPaused: Further pool updates are paused. Inspect the failure, then retry.
ota.targetHint: A node override takes priority over its pool. Choose an imported historical version to roll back. In-flight builds always finish first.
ota.importHint: Import a signed release from the configured GitHub repository. Version content is immutable.
ota.poolHint: One update at a time by default. Failure or rollback pauses further updates.

ai.settingsDescription: The platform stores model settings and encrypted keys. Agent workers inspect pinned snapshots and send validated plans to build nodes.
ai.noModelsHint: Add a model and select a default to analyze repositories and generate build plans.
ai.workerHint: Independent processes connect with mTLS and can only inspect snapshots, read logs and submit plans.
ai.noWorkersHint: Generate a one-time token, then run artifactory-agent-worker enroll.
ai.modelSecretHint: Keys are encrypted at rest and sent over an encrypted connection only to trusted task processes.
ai.enrollmentHint: Valid for 15 minutes and one use. Pass through standard input, never a command argument.
ai.keyHint: Leave empty when editing to keep the current key. Queries return a mask.
ai.projectModelHint: Select a project model or inherit the platform default.
ai.projectContextHint: Describe toolchains, constraints and product requirements here. The repository stays unchanged.
ai.submoduleHint: Same-origin submodules inherit the main credential. Bind cross-origin private repositories by their resolved URL.
ai.goalHint: AI inspects the pinned snapshot and generates commands and external scripts. Validated plans execute automatically.
ai.goalPlaceholder: For example: build the macOS arm64 CLI, run tests and collect the distributable binary.
ai.platformHint: Select native platforms, or leave empty for AI to choose from the goal and authorized nodes.
ai.zeroIntrusion: Repository access is read-only. Analysis, plans and scripts stay in artifactory. Tracked files and submodule state are checked after every step.
ai.planningHint: Waiting for source resolution or AI planning. A valid plan starts automatically.
ai.rpmHint: Optional pacing for the provider account limit.
